//: Hand-edited geometries that the bytecode-scanning tooling can't reach. Merged into entity_geometry.json by EntityModelLoader.loadGeometries with hand-edits taking precedence on key collision. Entries here survive tooling regenerations (entity_geometry.json is rewritten from scratch by ToolingEntityModels; this file is not).

geometries.//geometry.cold_cow: ColdCowModel.createBodyLayer (extends CowModel). Body REPLACED with 3 cubes (base 12x18x10 + inflated 0.5 + 4x6x1 udder); head REPLACED with main 8x8x6 + muzzle 6x3x1 at uv (9, 33). Two horn child bones (right_horn / left_horn) attached to head with PartPose.offsetAndRotation - 90deg X rotation, captured here as flat-pivot bones with absolute (head.pivot + offset) pivots since our parser doesn't keep the parent chain for tooling output. Legs inherited from QuadrupedModel.createBodyMesh.
geometries.//geometry.warm_cow: WarmCowModel.createBodyLayer (extends CowModel). Only head REPLACED - main head + muzzle (same as base) + 4 horn cubes inline (4x2x2 + 2x2x2 stubs on each side, the second pair authored via .mirror()). Legs and body inherited from createBaseCowModel. The mirrored cubes are at +X positions but reference the same UV strip - the kit's mirror flag handles the U-flip; cube origin/size match the post-mirror authored positions in vanilla.
geometries.//geometry.cold_chicken: ColdChickenModel.createBodyLayer (extends AdultChickenModel). Body REPLACED with main 6x8x6 + a 0x3x5 plane-cube tail at (0, 3, -1) uv (38, 9). Head REPLACED with main 4x6x3 (same as base) + new 6x3x4 crown cube at (-3, -7, -2.015) uv (44, 0). Vanilla's PartDefinition.addOrReplaceChild PRESERVES the existing PartDefinition's children, so beak + red_thing survive head replacement. Legs and wings inherited from createBaseChickenModel.
geometries.//geometry.cold_pig: ColdPigModel.createBodyLayer (extends PigModel). Only body REPLACED - base 10x16x8 + inflated 0.5 fur layer at uv (28, 32). Head and legs inherited from PigModel.createBasePigModel via QuadrupedModel.createBodyMesh(6, true, false). The CubeDeformation g argument is CubeDeformation.NONE for the cold pig registration.
geometries.//geometry.adultpiglin: AdultPiglinModel.createBodyLayer mesh = PlayerModel.createMesh(NONE, false) then head + body replaced via AbstractPiglinModel.addHead and finally head.clearChild("hat"). Bytecode tooling misses (a) the post-build hat clearing - kept in tooling output, dropped here to match; (b) PartPose.offset for right_arm / right_leg when resolving absolute pivots of right_sleeve / right_pants child overlay bones - tooling output had them at (0,0,0), floating the overlay cube into body space and dropping the 0.25 inflate that widens the right arm/leg silhouette. Fixed here: right_sleeve.pivot = (-5, 2, 0) matching right_arm; right_pants.pivot = (-1.9, 12, 0) matching right_leg. zombified_piglin (same vanilla layer per AdultZombifiedPiglinModel.createBodyLayer delegating to AdultPiglinModel) is redirected to geometry.adultpiglin via entity_models_overrides.json.
geometries.//geometry.donkey: DonkeyModel.createBodyLayer chain is AbstractEquineModel.createBodyMesh(NONE) .apply(DONKEY_TRANSFORMER) .apply(MeshTransformer.scaling(0.87)). Bytecode tooling captures the base mesh + final scaling but misses the DONKEY_TRANSFORMER.modifyMesh step which addOrReplaceChild replaces the base horse ears with taller donkey ears (cube -1,-7,0 size 2,7,1 uv 0,12) at PartPose.offsetAndRotation(1.25,-10,4, pi/12, 0, ±pi/12), and also adds left_chest / right_chest body children (the latter are hidden by the harness DonkeyModelMixin at zero state so neither pipeline renders them). Ear PartPose is baked here: cube origin gets the ear offset baked in (-1+1.25, -7-10, 0+4) = (0.25, -17, 4) for left; cube.pivot + cube.rotation = (15X, 0, ±15Z) so the kit applies the ear's own rotation around the ear anchor before the bone chain's 30X head_parts rotation. cube.pivot is in BONE-LOCAL coords = DONKEY_SCALE * ear_offset = (±1.0875, -8.7, 3.48). The kit's vanilla-shape T(p)*R bone chain + T(+cp)*R*T(-cp) cube-pivot composition produces bit-identical output to the previous absolute-frame chain.
